d:
Well, this is how you communicate with people who apparently don’t listen very well.

https://www.patreon.com/ladyvaliantcmx/posts/note-on-free-and-165951927

Funny enough, I was blocked on Patreon simply for saying that the Cabin in the Morning Woods Remix was a terrible idea, but after all the arguing, they finally published a proper clarification explaining how their release schedule actually works.

And that was basically the whole point from the beginning: communicate things clearly and stop hiding behind confusing timelines and technicalities.(We’ll just quietly ignore the whole pricing issue, since apparently they had nothing to say about that. XD)

Of course, I’m a leaker anyway, so I’m not exactly pretending to stand on some great moral high ground here. XD I just wanted the rules and timelines to actually be stated clearly.

So, to celebrate this small miracle of communication, here’s one of the comics they officially released for free.

Enjoy! owo
n: [Western] [Team lv] Tales from the tome - Nieghbog aftermath complete (english)
